Velocity is the rate of change of position with respect to time. Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity with respect to time. So acceleration is the _____ derivative of position.

```{devoirs_choices}
#| label: choices_khd.1.nslw
- 'first':
    correct: false
- 'second':
    correct: true
    feedback: 'Right. That is, the derivative with respect to time of the derivative with respect to time of position.'
- 'marginal':
    correct: false
- 'zero':
    correct: false
```
